sensevoice_aed.interpretation: Crying_and_sobbing is scored only as sob; Shout only as shouting; Whispering only as whispering. Screaming is reported separately without an Attune shouting target.

data_contract.split: Clip-disjoint train/validation/100-row inspection test. FSD50K does not provide speaker IDs; uploader metadata is not a speaker identity.
data_contract.licences: clip-level CC0 or CC BY only

fsd50k_frozen_probe.comparator_note: The previously reported AED values 0/0/0.32/0 are weak-label detection rates, not F1. With eight sob true positives, no sob false positives, and 17 sob false negatives in the committed raw outputs, sob one-vs-rest F1 is 0.484848; both metrics are named explicitly.

ontology_boundaries.scream: Separate source/probe class; never mapped to Attune shouting.
ontology_boundaries.sob: FSD50K Crying_and_sobbing maps to sob, never crying_speech.
ontology_boundaries.intensity: CREMA-D intensity is not used by this probe.

limitations: All dataset targets are source-labelled weak labels, not reviewed gold.
FSD50K Shout clips are standalone Freesound events, not speech-embedded shouting.
Crying_and_sobbing maps to sob, not crying_speech without clip-level speech review.
CREMA-D intensity is metadata only and is not mapped to shouting or whispering.
CREMA-D contains no surprise source category.
CREMA-D DIS maps to Attune other, never distress. Models without an other/disgust output therefore have structurally zero DIS recall.
No calibration, localization, abstention, OOD threshold, or gold review is completed.
